Introduction

Verdis Chain is a Substrate-based blockchain built with a native Delegated Proof-of-Stake (DPoS) consensus mechanism, an integrated AMM decentralized exchange (DEX), and a comprehensive eco-system featuring carbon credit tracking, green validator scoring, and reforestation logging.

Key Features
Native DPoS Consensus — 14 validator slots, green score weighting, delegate/stake mechanism
AMM DEX — Constant-product automated market maker built into the chain runtime
Eco System — On-chain carbon credits, reforestation logging, green validator scoring
EVM Compatibility — 143 opcodes including Cancun upgrade (TLOAD, TSTORE, MCOPY)
Solana-Inspired Features — Gulf Stream mempool, Turbine block propagation, ZK compression, ALT
IBC Support — Cross-chain communication via Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol

Feedback Form

Please understand that we can only assist with issues directly related to Verdis Chain services (Verdiscan, DEX, Wallet, Validators). Before writing in, please be informed that:

Pending Transactions

We do not process transactions and are therefore unable to expedite, cancel or replace them. Transactions are finalized by the DPoS validator network.

Verdiscan Block Explorer

Verdiscan is an independent block explorer for the Verdis Chain. We are unable to provide support for issues specific to other blockchains, wallets, or exchanges.

Community Support

We will never ask for your private keys or seed phrases. NEVER send us these. While we try our best to respond in a timely manner, we often have a backlog of inquiries. Please do not spam us.

Introduction

The Verdiscan API provides structured, queryable access to Verdis Chain on-chain data. It wraps the Substrate JSON-RPC into clean REST endpoints, pre-decoding extrinsics, categorizing transactions, and indexing validator and DEX data.

The API is organized into eight domains: Block, Transaction, Account, Token, Validators, DEX, Eco, and Network.

Base URL
https://verdischain.com/api/v1

All endpoints are relative to this base URL. Responses are JSON.

Authentication
Note: During testnet, all endpoints are publicly accessible without an API key. Mainnet will require API key authentication via the X-API-Key header.

For future mainnet access, include your API key in the request header:

# Mainnet (future)
curl -X GET "https://verdischain.com/api/v1/block/last" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
Rate Limits
PLAN	RATE LIMIT	COST
Testnet (Free)	100 req/min	Free
Developer (Future)	500 req/min	$29/mo
Pro (Future)	2,000 req/min	$99/mo
Enterprise (Future)	Custom	Contact us

Rate limit headers are included in every response: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.

Block
GET
/block/last
Get latest blocks
›

Returns the latest blocks on Verdis Chain, sorted by block number descending.

QUERY PARAMETERS
PARAM	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
limit	number	Number of blocks to return (1-100, default 20)
Try it: GET /block/last?limit=5
EXAMPLE RESPONSE
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "block": 599,
      "hash": "0x601281...0620cb",
      "parent_hash": "0x644e8c...af1084",
      "extrinsics": 2,

    }
  ],
  "count": 1
}

/block/{block_number}

›

Returns full block detail including extrinsics, digest logs, state root, and extrinsics root.
